anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, zero average confidence, and no opportunities or adjustments made, suggesting it might be inactive or malfunctioning.
Trading system shows zero total profit/loss (PL) and no active trades, which might indicate a halt in trading activities.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation.
Review and potentially restart AI systems to ensure they are functioning and contributing to trading strategies.
Evaluate trading strategies and system settings to ensure trades are being executed as expected.

recommendations.action: Perform an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any underlying issues.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degrade performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Check the status and logs of the AI system to diagnose why it is not performing learning cycles or generating opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can result in missed trading opportunities and reduced system effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Conduct a review of current trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are aligned with market conditions and functioning correctly.
